for Gaya Nalanda show registered pregnancy based rates for delivery and postnatal, 2022 to 2023

```sql
WITH delivery_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    "district",
    "year",
    "pregnancies_registered",
    "institutional_deliveries",
    CAST("institutional_deliveries" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF("pregnancies_registered", 0) * 100 AS delivery_rate_percentage
  FROM 
    "maternal_services"
  WHERE 
    "district" IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND
    "year" IN (2022, 2023)
),
postnatal_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    "district",
    "year",
    "pregnancies_registered",
    "postnatal_check_48h",
    CAST("postnatal_check_48h" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF("pregnancies_registered", 0) * 100 AS postnatal_rate_percentage
  FROM 
    "maternal_services"
  WHERE 
    "district" IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND
    "year" IN (2022, 2023)
)
SELECT 
  d."district",
  d."year" AS delivery_year,
  p."year" AS postnatal_year,
  d.delivery_rate_percentage,
  p.postnatal_rate_percentage
FROM 
  delivery_rate d
JOIN 
  postnatal_rate p ON d."district" = p."district" AND d."year" = p."year"
ORDER BY 
  d."district", d."year";
```
